strengths: RNA-only within-donor aggregation avoids joint-modality construction of the correspondence.
Source hg19 distance is prospectively primary with hg38 sensitivity, resolving S28 without trimming E2.
Linked/control construction is promoter-fixed and imposes symmetric accessibility/measurement support.
The frozen 14-feature nuisance basis is mapped to explicit NIH-CARD observables.
The out-of-span failure is carried forward as a claim limitation rather than repaired after outcomes.
No real-data minimum effect size is invented by transferring the synthetic M_MIN across units.
Structural and biological validation evidence remain separated.

F1_pairing_corrobation.finding: Canonical correctly marks the RNA/ATAC namespace unresolved. The proposed composite key is plausible, but C-2 donor/sample agreement is tautological because sample is part of the key itself; C-4 cohort agreement is largely inherited from sample identity and is not an independent pairing witness.
F1_pairing_corrobation.external_source_lineage: Public NIH-CARD scMAVERICS code provides stronger provenance: ATAC construction takes cell barcodes from RNA obs for each sample, creates atlas_identifier = barcode + '_' + sample_id, and the multiome merge defines paired nuclei by exact intersection of RNA and ATAC obs_names.
F1_pairing_corrobation.limitation: The exact scMAVERICS commit/version that produced Zenodo record 20834804 has not yet been cryptographically tied to the deposited final files in this audit.
required_repair: Amend the pairing gate so C-2/C-4 are labelled consistency checks, not independent corroboration.
Add pipeline-lineage corroboration from the depositor repository and, if possible, pin the producing commit/version or deposited workflow provenance.
Keep the composite bridge as a named assumption unless an authoritative depositor key or exact producing lineage closes it.
Cross-modal cell-type agreement may remain a corroborating check only if its provenance is shown not to be copied directly from one modality to the other.

F2_stage3_executor_incomplete.finding: The committed precondition script's stage3 currently computes only NIH-CARD peak-overlap attrition and qualifying donor counts. It does not yet construct matched controls, compute all 14 frozen features, or run the promised out-of-span Mahalanobis diagnostic.
F2_stage3_executor_incomplete.consequence: The design contract is frozen, but the executable precondition implementation does not yet satisfy its own stage-3 specification.
required_repair: Implement promoter-fixed matched-control construction exactly as frozen.
Implement the full 14-feature real-data mapping for linked and controls.
Recover the synthetic feature mean/SD, full ranges, and p99 Mahalanobis radius from the committed qualification lineage without recomputing or changing the estimator.
Emit the predeclared IN_SPAN/OUT_OF_SPAN verdict before stage4.

F3_four_metacell_precision.finding: A donor with the minimum four metacells contributes a Pearson correlation estimated from only four points. This is mathematically defined but extremely noisy; the current >=100 nuclei rule establishes estimability, not measurement precision.
F3_four_metacell_precision.why_not_change_threshold_now: No biological outcome has been opened, but inventing a larger cutoff without a precision criterion would simply replace one arbitrary threshold with another.
required_repair: Add an outcome-blind precision/stability qualification for the per-donor correlation as a function of metacell count.
Prefer an analytic or simulation-based measurement-error study using no E2 linked-vs-control outcomes.
Predeclare how low-metacell donors are handled if precision is inadequate: support stratum, precision weighting only if prospectively justified, or a revised minimum derived from the qualification.
Do not choose the rule after seeing Delta.

public_pipeline_evidence: scMAVERICS scripts/atac_by_celltype.py derives ATAC valid barcodes from RNA observation metadata and constructs atlas_identifier from barcode plus sample_id.
scMAVERICS scripts/multiome_merge.py computes paired_barcodes as the exact intersection of RNA and ATAC obs_names before constructing the MuData object.
